description: Passenger_Travel_Facts_and_Figures_Latest is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Research and Statistics", published or maintained by U.S. DOT/Bureau of Transportation Statistics. Passenger Travel Facts and Figures, developed by the Bureau of Transportation Statistics (BTS), is a snapshot of the characteristics and trends of personal travel in the United States; the network over which passenger travel takes place; and the related economic, safety, and environmental aspects of passenger travel. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Research and Statistics". It has 14 columns, among them Units, Name, Year , change_from_previous_year_1, Date, Year 1. The portal shows 2025-08-19 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. DOT/Bureau of Transportation Statistics. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
